name: Soil Moisture
description: Variations in soil moisture can affect traction and thus travel time. High likelihood due to the robot's weight and speed.

name: Crop Type
description: Different crops have varying heights and densities, affecting the robot's ability to navigate and causing variations in travel time.

name: Weather Conditions
description: Rain, sunlight, wind, and temperature can all impact the robot's performance and travel time.

name: Grass Density
description: Differences in grass density along Path 2 can affect the robot's traction and travel time.

name: Wheel Wear
description: Worn or uneven wheels can cause variations in travel time due to reduced traction and uneven speed.

name: Battery State
description: Low battery levels can cause the robot to travel more slowly or take longer to recover, affecting travel time.

name: Charging Schedule
description: Inconsistent or infrequent charging can lead to variations in battery level and travel time.

name: Route Maintenance
description: Unmaintained or uneven routes can cause variations in travel time due to reduced traction or uneven speed.

name: Robot Mass
description: Variations in the robot's mass due to payload or fuel level can affect its speed and travel time.

name: Temperature
description: High or low temperatures can impact the robot's performance and travel time.

name: Light Intensity
description: Variations in light intensity due to weather conditions or time of day can affect the robot's ability to navigate.

name: Camera Calibration
description: Incorrect or inconsistent camera calibration can lead to navigation errors and variations in travel time.

name: Sensor Maintenance
description: Inadequate or inconsistent sensor maintenance can lead to navigation errors and variations in travel time.

name: Controller Settings
description: Incorrect or inconsistent controller settings can cause variations in travel time due to changes in speed or navigation behavior.

name: Software Updates
description: Inadequate or infrequent software updates can lead to navigation errors and variations in travel time.
